question: Which country became the first team to qualify for the 2026 FIFA World Cup (excluding host nations)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Japan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Japan** officially became the first nation to qualify for the **2026 FIFA World Cup** through the qualification process, excluding the three host nations who receive automatic berths.
 
• The "Samurai Blue" secured their mathematical qualification on **March 20, 2025**, following a decisive victory in the **AFC (Asian Football Confederation) Third Round** of qualifiers.
 
• Competing in **Group C** of the Asian qualifiers, **Japan** maintained a dominant run under the management of head coach **Hajime Moriyasu**, ensuring a top-two finish in their group with several games to spare.
 
• This achievement marks **Japan's 8th consecutive** appearance in the **FIFA World Cup**, a streak that began in **1998** when the tournament was held in **France**.
 
• The qualification was confirmed after **Japan** accumulated enough points to be beyond the reach of the third-placed team in their qualifying group, effectively utilizing the expanded **8.5 slots** allocated to **Asia** for the upcoming tournament.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **2026 FIFA World Cup Expansion:**
 
 
• The **2026** edition will be the first to feature **48 teams**, an increase from the **32-team** format used since **1998**.
 
• This expansion allows more teams from **Asia (AFC)**, **Africa (CAF)**, and **North America (CONCACAF)** to participate in the global event.
 
 
 
• **Host Nations:**
 
 
• The tournament will be historically unique as it is co-hosted by three countries: the **United States**, **Canada**, and **Mexico**.
 
• All three host nations qualify **automatically** and are not required to participate in the regional qualification rounds.
 
 
 
• **Other AFC Contenders:**
 
 
• **South Korea**: Holds the record for the most World Cup appearances by an **Asian** nation (**11 times**) and was among the next teams to qualify shortly after **Japan**.
 
• **Iran**: Known as "Team Melli," they are a powerhouse in **West Asia** and have been consistent qualifiers in recent cycles (**2014, 2018, 2022**).
 
• **Australia**: After moving from the **OFC** to the **AFC** in **2006**, the "Socceroos" have qualified for every tournament, often through intense **inter-continental play-offs**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Tournament Timeline:** The **2026 FIFA World Cup** is scheduled to take place from **June 11** to **July 19, 2026**.
 
• **Venues:** A total of **16 cities** across the three host countries will host matches, with the final match set to be played at **MetLife Stadium** in **East Rutherford, New Jersey**.
 
• **Qualification Slots:** The **AFC** received a significant boost in slots, moving from **4.5** to **8.5**, which facilitated the early qualification of top-tier teams like **Japan**.
 
• **Historical Context:** **Mexico** will become the first country to host or co-host the **FIFA World Cup** three times, having previously hosted in **1970** and **1986**.
